3D Artist (m/w/d) gesucht – Vollzeit | München
Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens in München suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „3D Grafikdesigner / 3D Artist (m/w/d)“.
Aufgaben
Sie erstellen komplexe 3D-Animationen und 3D-Grafiken für digitale Lern- und Trainingsanwendungen mit Blender
Als Teil des Entwicklungsteams entwickeln Sie Assets und Szenen für VR-, AR- und Realtime-Anwendungen auf Basis von Game Engines wie Unity oder Godot
Sie bereiten bestehende CAD-Daten auf, optimieren Modelle für Echtzeitanwendungen und reduzieren Geometrien bedarfsgerecht
Darüber hinaus modellieren Sie 3D-Objekte und erstellen Texturen, Materialien sowie Shader für unterschiedliche Einsatzszenarien
Zusätzlich entwickeln Sie bestehende 3D-Grafiken und Animationen weiter und passen diese an neue Anforderungen an
Qualifikation
Grundlage bildet eine technische oder gestalterische Ausbildung, beispielsweise als Mediengestalter Digital und Print (m/w/d), Technischer Produktdesigner (m/w/d), Gamedesigner (m/w/d) oder Technischer Systemplaner (m/w/d), alternativ ein entsprechendes Studium
Sie bringen bereits mindestens erste Berufserfahrung als 3D Artist (m/w/d), Technical Artist (m/w/d), 3D Grafikdesigner (m/w/d) oder Multimedia Designer (m/w/d) mit
Sie verfügen über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Blender sowie über praktische Erfahrung in der Erstellung von 3D-Modellen, Animationen und Realtime-Inhalten
Zusätzlich sind gute Kenntnisse in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator und After Effects sowie Erfahrungen mit Game Engines wie Unity oder Godot wünschenswert
Wichtig sind technisches Verständnis, Teamfähigkeit sowie eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

IG-Metall-Tarifvertrag : Hier erwartet Sie eine attraktive Bezahlung nach dem IG-Metall Tarifvertrag

Teamspirit : Sie erwarten flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege sowie eine wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit

Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.
With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.
This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.
What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.
Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.
At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

As a Senior 3D Gameplay Artist (Animation & VFX) , you'll play a key role in owning the visual and motion game feel of our gameplay mechanics, from greybox to shipped asset, so that objects read as fun before a player ever touches them. You'll work directly with art direction, game design, and gameplay engineers on All in Hole, a top-50 grossing title, on the elements players interact with most. Your main responsibilities will include:
Own game feel end to end: take a mechanic from greybox and UX blockout through animation, VFX, and final sign-off
Animate gameplay objects by hand: idle, activation, interaction feedback, and state transitions, with real command of timing, weight, anticipation, and follow-through
Build VFX and shaders that land the hit: impact, feedback, and state change that communicate clearly without drowning the read of the object
Translate concept into 3D without losing its soul: match the intent, elevate the charm, and challenge the concept early when the gameplay asks for something different
Iterate directly in Unity: prefabs, colliders, animator state machines, and enough technical range to test your own ideas in minutes rather than hand them off
This is a great opportunity to own the craft that players remember most, on a game already in the global top 50, with no one ahead of you in the queue — the person in this seat sets the bar for how gameplay objects look, move, and feel.

We are looking for someone with around +5 years of experience building 3D core gameplay animations in mobile games, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:
3D animation craft: hand-keyed work that gives personality and weight to objects that aren't characters, grounded in animation fundamentals rather than tooling
Strong VFX skills: particle systems and impact effects timed to reinforce readability, not decorate it
A core gameplay brain: you're a gamer, you read design intent off a prototype, and you can hold a real conversation with designers about why a mechanic is or isn't fun
Working fluency in Unity: blockouts, prefabs, animator and state machines, and the technical range to unblock yourself
Genuine shader ability: you can write and debug your own, not just wire up existing ones
Fidelity to concept: you hit the intent of a concept closely while making it better through the 3D pipeline
Clear visual communication: storyboards and blockouts that get every stakeholder seeing the same outcome before work starts
Autonomy and initiative : you hold a quality bar without it being checked for you, and you bring the unrequested improvement alongside the requested one

Can concept the idea yourself and push it forward
Have worked with physics-based gameplay
Have mentored or reviewed other artists' work
Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We're building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:
Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow — we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.
Curiosity: We continuously seek the "why" behind the "what" — we explore with purpose and practicality.
Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider — we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
Ambition: We strive for the best — we don't settle for "good enough" — we use common sense to reach higher.

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect:
🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you'll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
📈 Performance Reviews: We're committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we'll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.
Where We Hire
Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we've designed a space people genuinely enjoy — all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).
We also have incredible team members across Europe — from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you're working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you're fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there — or planning to be — we'd love to hear from you!

Hopetown is a narrative-first RPG inspired by Disco Elysium, set in a decaying town haunted by both ghosts and memories. You play a washed-up ghost hunter unravelling disappearances, a crumbling world, and your own haunted past.
Blending surrealism, dialogue-driven gameplay, and psychological exploration, Hopetown is being built by key talent from some of the most celebrated narrative games of the past decade — including Martin Luiga (founder of the ZA/UM Cultural Movement), Lenval Brown (narrator of Disco Elysium), Piotr Sobolewski (former CEO of Knights of Unity), and Paweł Błaszczak (composer on The Witcher and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt).
We are currently moving into early production, building out the foundational systems, characters, and mechanics that will define the experience. With your help, we can transform Hopetown from a great CRPG into an unforgettable one — a living, breathing universe of stories, surprises, and challenges.

Longdue is a studio founded to create rich, emotional, story-first games that challenge players’ expectations. We’re a remote team of writers, artists, designers, and engineers, bringing together talent from across the industry to push the boundaries of narrative-driven RPGs.
We are still early in production — meaning new team members will have a real, tangible impact on the world we are building. We believe that extraordinary games can come from small, focused teams — teams that value creativity, openness, and care over convention.

At Longdue , we’re building a 2.5D isometric RPG - focusing on lightly stylised, clean 3D shapes with a painterly and moody finish.
We’re looking for a passionate 3D artist to join our small, fully remote art team. You will serve as an early addition to the team, helping create Hopetown from the ground up. You’ll be modelling environments, characters and props, while working closely with the art director and art team to establish pipelines and develop the style of the game.
The ideal candidate is comfortable with every part of the 3D modelling pipeline, and has experience working effectively with concept artists, animators, riggers and tech artists. We want to see someone who is flexible, eager to iterate, comfortable with remote working, and loves narrative-driven games.

2+ years of professional experience in 3D modelling and texturing for games.
Experience working in Unity.
A strong passion for games and art.
A strong knowledge of art theory. The ideal candidate has a good eye for composition, shape design, colour theory, and other design principles.

Experience working in a small or early-stage studio, with comfort in wearing multiple hats.
Experience with stylised or painterly visual aesthetics.
Interest in narrative games and world-building through environmental storytelling.
Knowledge of other parts of the pipeline, such as rigging/animation or material setup, is a plus, though not required.

💡 About Zack D. Films
Zack D. Films, a prominent YouTube channel known for its innovative and engaging content, is looking for highly skilled Contract 3D Animators to join the team. This is not an entry-level opportunity, we are seeking experienced artists capable of producing scroll‑stopping, top‑tier visuals that push the boundaries of animated shorts. We raise the bar every day, and we expect our animators to do the same.

As a Contract 3D Animator, you will collaborate with our producers to craft captivating 20–45 second 3D clips . These animations are a vital component of our storytelling, adding depth and excitement to our videos.
We’re hiring for multiple contract roles and welcome candidates from around the world. A strong understanding of the English language is required to ensure smooth communication and collaboration.
Please review the following videos, if you feel confident you could create something of similar or higher quality, we’d love to see your work:

Collaborate with producers to conceptualize and produce high‑quality, visually striking 3D animations .
Deliver animations quickly without compromising quality . If the test project takes longer than one day to complete at a high standard, this role may not be the right fit.
Ensure all animations meet the creative vision of the channel and are delivered on schedule.
Maintain a high level of craftsmanship in character animation, camera work, lookdev, shader effects, and simulations.

Be part of a rapidly growing team & one of the most viewed YouTube channels in the world.
Work on projects that reach hundreds of millions of viewers worldwide.
Opportunities for consistent work, week after week, all year round.
Join an online community of animators for support, collaboration, and shop talk.

Proven, professional-level experience in 3D animation and editing.

What software they are proficient in

Test Project (Required to Apply)
Please find the test project here. (< Click the link to access)

📱 Aspect Ratio: 9:16
💰 Pay: Unpaid test; if approved, you’ll begin working on paid projects
⏰ Deadline: No set deadline, but sooner is better
What if I don’t want to do the test?
There is an alternative option : Submit one edited video under 60 seconds showcasing all of the following:
Original character animation
VFX / simulation capabilities
Lookdev abilities
Modeling abilities
This must be delivered as one single edited clip . No folders of individual clips will be reviewed. Links must be direct to the reel not to a general artist page.
Why is there an unpaid test?
Due to the one-of-a-kind nature of our videos, showreels and portfolios are often missing the proper examples needed to evaluate your potential with us. Not only is the test designed to show us everything we need to see, it's also been crafted to ensure a quick turnaround is possible, with most experienced artists completing it after a couple of hours.
What style should I follow?
Follow our YouTube Shorts style: Zack D. Films Shorts
What if I don’t have time right now?
No worries — you can return to the test whenever you're ready.
Can I deviate from the animation notes?
Yes! They’re there to guide you, but we love creative approaches that elevate the final product. This is your opportunity to impress us with smooth animation, great timing, and creative camera work.
Highlights
Collaborate with our producers to craft captivating 20-45 second 3D clips. These animations are a vital component of our storytelling, adding depth and excitement to our videos.
